_why: Which closed attempt each Results page shows. Inputs only. A page either closes a Submit scenario (04-submit.fixture.json) with ATT.complete on the given date, or shows the completed attempt Pages 1 and 3 already show ("done"), optionally with a new attempt in progress beside it ("current", a Submit scenario left open). One scenario is new here: a whole-paper attempt whose only submission the marker was too busy to mark, so nothing in it was marked. Every status, count, mark and reason on the pages is derived by ATT.results through the shipped contract; reasons are read from app.js.

05-results.html.note: the whole paper, mixed: the primary proposal

05-results-complete.html.note: everything marked, the completed attempt Pages 1 and 3 show

05-results-again.html.note: the last result, viewed while a new attempt is in progress

05-results-nothing.html.note: an attempt in which nothing was marked
